summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of JARVIS AI (Expo/RN + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend pytest: 11/11 passed (auth register/login/me, duplicate 400, wrong-pw 401, vehicles CRUD + activate uniqueness, chat with GPT 5.4 + persisted history, TTS base64 audio). Frontend Playwright (mobile 390x844): login flow OK, dashboard renders animated orb + OBD-II indicator + 8 gauges + voice FAB, bottom tabs Command/Live/JARVIS/Health/Garage all navigate, Live Diagnostics shows sensor chips + line chart + sensor rows, AI Repair Assistant sent real message and received full JARVIS diagnostic reply (misfire/spark plugs/vacuum leak), Health shows scores/DTCs (P0300/P0171)/reminders, Garage add-vehicle modal opens with all testIDs (nickname/make/model/year/engine/vin + save-vehicle-button) and existing My Jeep vehicle shows SET ACTIVE + delete.

issues: React Native web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only, no functional impact.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Replace deprecated shadow* / pointerEvents style props with boxShadow and style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web warnings.
(Optional) Voice transcribe endpoint was verified only for the auth gate (401 unauth). Full STT round-trip not exercised because no sample audio available — matches request note.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:173 list_vehicles skips _id/user_id correctly; Vehicle model round-trip safe.
server.py:186 activate_vehicle sets all inactive first then activates one — correctly enforces single-active invariant.
server.py:215 chat prepends telemetry+vehicle context into system message and persists both user and assistant messages — matches contract.
server.py:266 transcribe writes upload to tempfile and cleans up in finally — good.
JWT secret is stored in backend/.env (not committed via protected list) — fine for preview.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (login, dashboard, diagnostics, assistant chat, health, garage modal)

seed_data_creation: Test user mechanic@jarvis.ai / Jarvis2026! already present. Tests create TEST_-prefixed vehicles and delete them at end of test_vehicles_flow. Chat sessions use unique test_<uuid> session_ids.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend BASE URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py reads that with a preview URL fallback. Bottom-tab labels are Command/Live/JARVIS/Health/Garage (Live=Diagnostics, JARVIS=Assistant). Add Vehicle testIDs: vehicle-input-{name|make|model|year|engine|vin}, save-vehicle-button, add-vehicle-button, vehicle-{id}, activate-{id}, delete-{id}, logout-button. Assistant testIDs: chat-input, send-button, mic-button, message-user-N, message-assistant-N.
